scope: Extend the exact operator== and operator!= partial domains to owners with owned/proxy accessor results, removing their accidental dependency on borrowed IndexedCursorSource getters. No full class/API/toolkit parity claim.
shared_implementation: Existing is_equal delegates to is_equal_with; existing inequality delegates equality; new inequality negates the same policy body. Existing More owner validation is reused. FnOnce callbacks are consumed at most once, in native left-to-right short-circuit order. No new unsafe code, lifetime extension or duplicate owner state.
native_behavior: Native operator== evaluates (!More() && !other.More()) before comparing owner and index. More invokes Size through the respective const/nonconst container pointer and never reads values or keys. Native owned noncopy/nonmovable accessor results instantiate successfully for these comparisons.
row_join: All 12 native stdout rows are computed independently in Rust and compared exactly, including live/same-owner, foreign live, exhausted pairs, native index zero, changed Size, default/null, and mixed const/nonconst Size traces. Getter trace symbols v/k never occur during comparison rows.
rust_specific_checks: Foreign left owner rejects before either callback.
Live left skips foreign right validation and its callback.
Exhausted left validates foreign right before evaluating its callback.
Callbacks consuming unique owned String captures demonstrate true FnOnce support.
An owned non-Clone value and owned key remain independently accessible through existing policy adapters; comparison invokes only Size.

compiler_capture.integrity: Pinned raw compiler normalized independently; each selected body must match declaration hash, full impl context and current file hash. Four selected bodies remain partial; selector existence alone grants no behavior completion credit.

ledger_transaction.scope: Exact base ledger with only the two owned rows replaced. Current root may contain unrelated class transactions, but owned row mutations and relevant stale body hashes fail replay.

original_tests.scope: Existing concrete Map/DataMap/DoubleMap/IndexedMap/IndexedDataMap native passing names join Rust passing names exactly. Existing assertions and test mappings unchanged; no new full assertion-faithfulness re-audit or claim that all maps use this cursor.

limitations: Size callbacks explicitly select const/nonconst behavior; shared Rust references require sound interior mutability when a native nonconst Size implementation changes owner state. No aliasing bypass or arbitrary mutation policy is supplied.
Native More/comparisons are noexcept. Throwing native Size leads to termination; Rust panic termination equivalence is not claimed or treated as an oracle result.
Owner identity validates live explicit Rust owner references; dangling native pointers, Rust owner relocation/reused addresses and arbitrary raw object layouts are outside this safe adapter domain.
The prior direct is_equal/is_not_equal API retains its reference-valued trait bound; proxy callers use the newly bound explicit policy methods.
Overloaded operator& and ordinary prvalue arrow domains remain unchanged; no primitive foreign-impl or exposed-private-return inventory change.
historical_scope: Prior receipts remain immutable historical captures. comparisons.rs changes its hash in this batch; current proof for the two updated methods is here. Unmodified native declarations and source methods are not relabeled as new behavior.
